officialLinks.label: Grades, GPA formula, P/NP, temporary grades, academic standing

helpIntro: UC Irvine uses a 4.0 UC GPA scale. Enter quarter units and finalized grades; A+/A=4.0, plus/minus grades adjust by 0.3, and F=0. P/NP and temporary notations are excluded while unresolved.
helpNote: For standard undergraduate UC GPA planning. The calculator displays three decimals. Repeat Impact is disabled because UCI replacement applies only to the first 16 repeated units and depends on transcript history. Graduate and PharmD contexts need separate review.
helpExample: A 4-unit A earns 16.0 grade points and a 4-unit B+ earns 13.2; 29.2 ÷ 8 = 3.650.

gradeExplanations.F: F earns zero grade points and its units count in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass is excluded from GPA; unit credit is earned.
gradeExplanations.NP: Not Pass is excluded from GPA and earns no unit credit.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded while unresolved; it can later convert to the applicable permanent grade.
gradeExplanations.IP: In Progress is excluded until the sequence receives final grades.
gradeExplanations.NR: No Report is excluded while unresolved and can later convert to F, NP, or U.
gradeExplanations.W: Withdrawal carries no grade points and is excluded from the UC GPA.
gradeExplanations.UR: Unauthorized Repeat carries no credit or grade points.

specialTypes.name: UCI course, standard letter/P-NP grading
specialTypes.note: Use for standard UCI undergraduate courses with finalized transcript grades.

specialTypes.name: Course from another UC campus included in UC GPA
specialTypes.note: Use only when the course and grade are on your UC record and included in the UC GPA.

specialTypes.name: Non-UC transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Accepted non-UC transfer units do not enter the UC GPA.

specialTypes.name: Repeated course needing transcript review
specialTypes.note: UCI replaces eligible deficient grades only within the first 16 repeated units; later repetitions and multiple attempts require record-specific review.

specialTypes.name: PharmD H/F course or other professional grading
specialTypes.note: PharmD H/F grades are not calculated like the standard undergraduate letter-grade GPA.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled. Use your official UC GPA baseline or confirm which attempts count on your transcript before modeling repeated work.
